author: Microsoft
name: Reactor Single-File App (Experimental)
description: Experimental. Creates a blank Microsoft.UI.Reactor (WinUI 3) desktop app as a single-file .NET 10 file-based app: one .cs file whose #:package and #:property directives replace the .csproj. Pure C#, no XAML. Run it with 'dotnet run <name>.cs'. Microsoft.UI.Reactor is prerelease and its API may change.

dotnetVersion.description: Base target framework moniker (TFM). File-based apps and Microsoft.UI.Reactor require .NET 10 or later.

windowsAppSdkVersion.description: Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK NuGet version. Requires 2.2.0 or later; use * for the latest stable.

windowsSdkBuildToolsWinAppVersion.description: Microsoft.Windows.SDK.BuildTools.WinApp NuGet version. Requires 0.7.0 or later (file-based app support); use * for the latest stable.

skipRestore.description: If specified, skips the automatic restore of the app on create.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this app.
